svg.title: macOS · Photo viewer / grading editor · Masks tab · 1000×700
svg.desc: Mirrors App/PhotoViewerView.swift (masksTab, controlRail, the register-shape members: selectedShapeID / shapeTool / shapeSquareLock / selectedRegisterShapeIndex) hosting App/Overlay/OverlayMasksPanel.swift (toolbar, shapeToolMenu, deckCard, detailCard, shapesCard, RegisterShapeTile, customMasksCard) with App/Overlay/MaskShapeOverlay.swift on the picture. Code first, mirrored from the running app 2026-09-11 (captures mac-masks-mask-selected.png, 1000×700, and mac-masks-mask-selected-tall.png, 1000×1000, both 2×; window top at px 52, left at px 68 — the shadow is offset downward, so the vertical margin is NOT the 68 px the horizontal one is). Staged by LL_EDITOR=<the "Photo 9. 9. at 09:26" single still> LL_RAIL=masks with the Circle mask selected. STATE DRAWN: the Masks tab with a MASK SELECTED — the deck's Circle (a Radial mask made from the register's found ellipse through "Use as Radial mask") and its detail card, then the Shapes card below it. The rail is NOT scrolled: the 700 pt window clips the Shapes card after its header ("Shapes · 5 shapes"), exactly as the capture shows; the card is nevertheless drawn in full geometry under the window clip, so the source carries the whole rail — scrolling instead would have pushed the deck off the top, and the deck is what says which mask the detail card belongs to. THE RULE THIS TAB OBEYS, unchanged since 2026-09-07: a mask has two homes — this tab owns a mask’s SHAPE (create it, drag its handles, feather it, tune the semantic dials, see what text is placed in it) and the EDITOR tab owns its GRADE (photo-viewer.mask-grade.svg). The TAB IS THE MODE: a drag on the picture here draws masks or shapes; a drag on the picture in Editor sets an armed slider. RAIL TABS: RailTabBar shows THREE seats here — Editor · Text · Masks — because availableRailTabs adds Frames only where allFrames.count > 1; this project is a single still, so there is nothing to nominate and the tab does not exist. (The 2026-09-07 drawing carried a fourth "Frames" seat from an interval project.) 308×36 white capsule, 3 pt inset, 2 pt between seats (99.3 pt each), the selected seat an accent capsule with a white 13/600 label. TOOLBAR (30 pt, four equal buttons, 8 pt gaps): Linear and Radial (white, radius 9, accent 12.5/600 label) arm a creation tool — filled accent while armed; the next drag on the picture draws one and the tool disarms itself, so there is no mode to get stuck in; a drag under 8 pt is discarded rather than committed as an invisible mask. ＋ SHAPE is NEW (2026-09-10): a Menu button — Ellipse / Rectangle / Square, plus a Divider and Cancel while a tool is armed — with the resting label "＋ Shape". The code styles it like ＋ Custom… (accent 4% fill, dashed accent-45% 1.5 pt border), but AS SHIPPED on macOS the borderlessButton menu style drops the label’s background and overlay, so it renders as a bare accent label in its 67.25 pt seat between two bordered buttons — drawn as captured, flagged for the code. While armed the button fills accent, its label goes white and reads the armed tool with a tick — "Ellipse ✓", "Rectangle ✓" or "Square ✓" (Square = the quad tool with the square lock on) — and the next drag on the picture draws that shape into the register (shapes.json), not a mask. LL_SHAPETOOL=ellipse|rect|square arms it at launch. ＋ Custom… opens the file importer. AS SHIPPED the ＋ Custom… label wraps onto two lines ("＋" over "Custom…") inside its 30 pt button at this width, spilling above and below it — mirrored, not fixed. RAIL WIDTH: the tab bar is 308 pt (rail 340 − 16 − 16), but the scrolled content below it measures 293 pt here because the ScrollView reserves a 15 pt gutter for its scroller (the thumb at x 1009–1017 is drawn); in the 1000-tall capture with the shorter shape-selected rail the content ran the full 308. MASKS DECK: a 3-column grid of 4:3 tiles (83×62.25, 8 pt gaps, radius 6), one per project mask in menu order — the two semantic regions, then the custom files, then the drawn shapes. White in a tile is the region that version SELECTS. Sky and Land carry the AUTO chip (they re-segment per seam) and draw the cached analysis — here Sky selects the frame’s top half behind a jagged horizon while Land renders all-white: that is what the cached analysis holds for this frame, mirrored as captured. An amber dot bottom-right marks a mask graded inside; ⊘ bottom-left marks one graded inverted; the legend under the tiles says so in two lines. The selection is a 2.5 pt accent ring drawn INSIDE the tile (strokeBorder). Clicking the selected tile deselects. The header trails the count in the mono face ("3 masks"). DETAIL CARD for the selected mask (14 pt padding, 12 pt rows): a 30×24 tile, the editable name "Circle" 14/700 (parametric masks only), Remove 12/600 secondary (parametric only — Sky and Land belong to the analysis, a custom mask is removed where its file is), then the Shape | Text LLInkSegment CENTRED in the card: #E9E9EB track (135×37, radius 9, 2 pt inset), the selected seat LL.ink (71.5×33, radius 7) with an LL.amber 14/700 label, the other seat’s label primary. SHAPE · a radial: Feather as a PERCENTAGE OF ITS OWN SPAN (50% here) and Rotation −90…90° (−10°) as native macOS sliders — 12.5/600 secondary label at the left, the grey 4 pt track from x 788 to 925, a 20 pt white knob, the value right-aligned in the mono face — then the footnote "225 × 209 pt · drag the handles on the picture to move and resize it." (the size is in points of the DRAWN picture: the same mask read 294 × 273 pt in the 1000-tall window), the Show mask checkbox (14 pt, off) and GRADE IN EDITOR: two 36 pt rows on accent-4% (radius 9), each with its own 30×24 tile — "Grade Circle" and "Grade Circle · inverted" (the inverted tile is white with the ink ellipse and the amber ⊘) — either CREATES-OR-OPENS the MaskGrade (unique on (mask, inverted)) and switches to the Editor tab with it expanded; a row whose grade exists reads the grade’s summary instead. Feather semantics unchanged: radial — everything inside 1 − feather of the radius is fully selected, falling to 0 at the ellipse; linear — the 50% line is the midpoint of start→end and the transition spans feather × distance centred on it. SHAPE · Sky or Land and SHAPE · Custom keep their 2026-09-07 dials (Camera locked off, Threshold, Feather, Edge bias, provenance; the inverted-name field and Replace Sky & Land) — desc-only here, the photo-viewer.mask-grade.svg lineage documents them. TEXT segment: the layers placed in this region, or the empty line. SHAPES CARD (NEW, shapesCard): the project’s register — "Shapes" 13/600 secondary with the mono count "5 shapes", then a 3-column LazyVGrid (8 pt columns, 10 pt rows) of RegisterShapeTile: an LL.ink 4:3 tile (radius 7) with the picture’s own aspect letterboxed inside it (a 3:4 frame here, 46 pt wide, ruled by a 0.5 pt white-25% hairline) and the shape filled white-90% at its place in that frame; under each tile a caption "◎ Square" / "◎ Square" / "◎ Rectangle" / "◎ Circle" / "✎ Square" — the 9 pt glyph is the source (◎ found by Find shapes, ✎ drawn here) and the 11/600 name is the family (Circle / Oval / Square / Rectangle, or the user’s own name); the legend "◎ found by Find shapes · ✎ drawn here · an ellipse can become a Radial mask" 10.5 pt secondary wraps to two lines at this width. Clicking a tile selects the shape (exclusive with the deck’s selection — selecting one clears the other) and puts its handles on the picture: that state, with the shape detail card, is photo-viewer.masks.shape.svg. With no shapes the card reads "No shapes yet. Run Find shapes from the Create tab, or draw one with ＋ Shape. Shapes are what a Shape-mation holds still." (desc-only). CUSTOM MASKS CARD (below the fold at 700 pt, desc-only; measured in mac-masks-default.png): "Custom Masks" 13/600 secondary with the mono "0 masks", one row per imported file, the 58 pt "＋ Add Custom Mask" drop target (dashed accent-45% border on accent-4%, radius 10; 13/600 accent title over "Drop a black & white PNG or JPEG" 10.5 pt tertiary) and the footnote "Masks belong to the project, not the layer — every text layer can pick any of them, and any of them can carry a grade." 11.5 pt secondary. DEFAULT STATE (nothing selected, mac-masks-default.png; described, not drawn): toolbar, deck, Shapes card, Custom Masks card in that order with no detail card and no picture chrome — the deck 152–323, the Shapes card 335–596, Custom Masks from 608, its footnote cut by the window’s bottom edge. PICTURE: the 3:4 still is fitted to the 660×672 pane (504×672 at x 98) with no timeline strip — a single still has no clock — and the ⤢ zoom control bottom-trailing. Over it the SELECTED MASK’s handles (MaskShapeOverlay, radial): a 1.2 pt white outline (drag inside to move; centre (372.5, 409), semi-axes 112.5 × 104.5, −10°), a dashed white-55% inner ellipse at 1 − feather marking where the falloff begins, four 11 pt white squares with a 1.5 pt LL.amber border at the cardinals, turned WITH the ellipse (E/W set radiusX, N/S radiusY), and beyond the east cardinal a 1 pt white stalk of MaskShape.rotationStalkPoints (26 pt) to a 14 pt white knob with the amber border and a 6 pt amber arrow.clockwise. Below min(rx, ry) = 26 pt the cardinals collapse under the caption "small mask · handles collapsed — zoom in to edit" (desc-only). Handles take a drag BEFORE the armed-slider gesture. STATES NOT DRAWN: the armed ＋ Shape label, the create-drag HUD pill, the Text segment populated, the model-missing deck (Sky and Land dimmed to 40% and unclickable), the magenta "Show mask" tint. Hooks: LL_EDITOR=<uuid|latest>, LL_RAIL=masks, LL_MASKGRADE=shapes|first|empty, LL_MASKTOOL=linear|radial, LL_SHAPETOOL=ellipse|rect|square. Verified against the running Mac app 2026-09-11.

mirrors App/PhotoViewerView.swift (masksTab) + App/Overlay/OverlayMasksPanel.swift — a mask's GRADE lives in photo-viewer.mask-grade.svg, a found shape's handles in photo-viewer.masks.shape.svg
